span.p:
PreparedDataset
train_df · val_df · test_df
feature_columns · price_column
memmap_train_paths

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Group 18 training parquet files by symbol
6 symbol groups × 3 days each
(sorted alphabetically: AAPL·AMZN·AVGO·META·MSFT·TSLA)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Per-symbol pipeline fitting (6 × fit)
For each symbol:
concat its 3 raw training-day DataFrames
FeaturePipeline.fit(combined)
Welford online normalisation
session boundary reset at gaps > 1 h
free combined + gc.collect()

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Transform 18 training files
For each file i:
load_parquet(path_i).dropna()
features = pipeline[symbol].transform(raw)
merged = concat(raw, features)
HFT: derive close = (bid_px_00 + ask_px_00) / 2
HFT: deduplicate timestamps (1 µs min gap)
save_symbol_memmap → {i}_train_data.npy
free merged + gc.collect()

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Transform 6 val files
For each val_path_j:
load_parquet(path_j).dropna()
features = pipeline[symbol].transform(raw)
merged = concat(raw, features)
HFT post-process
split at midpoint (50/50):
val_j = merged[:mid] → tmp parquet
test_j = merged[mid:] → tmp parquet
free merged + gc.collect()

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Assemble val_df / test_df
val_df = pd.concat(val_j for j in 0..5)
test_df = pd.concat(test_j for j in 0..5)
Re-deduplicate timestamps after concat
(fix cross-symbol collisions)
train_df = first_train_df (reference only)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
validate_prepared_data()
• non-empty train / val / test
• close column present
• feature_* columns present
• no NaN in train split

span.p:

ensure_close_column_for_hft()
close = (bid_px_00 + ask_px_00) / 2
ensure_unique_index_for_hft_tradingenv()
deduplicate timestamps 1 µs gap
